allowed_claims: Demonstrate discrete ligand-feature to pocket-feature matching with audited QUBO constraints.
Compare the quantum-observed candidate, complete-enumeration optimum, and co-crystal-derived reference as separate results.
limitations: Only the minimal derived feature model is packaged; the source mmCIF is identified by checksum but is not bundled.
The fixture supports a fixed educational matching problem, not arbitrary ligand docking.
Local simulation only; no hardware execution or quantum advantage claim.
